package.name: servo_controller
package.description:
Pan/tilt actuation for the classroom camera stand.
Replaces the legacy Trigger-based motor node with an action server that enforces travel limits, applies acceleration ramping, supports homing and calibration, and reports stalls and emergency stops explicitly. The audit found no stall detection and no e-stop anywhere in the original code because the std_srvs/Trigger interface had nowhere to report one.
